Smash or Trash 

High Protein Chocolate Brownie 

Original Recipe @nickkaz.fit 

Ingredients for Cookie Batter:

Wet:
40g (3 tbsp) Plain or Vanilla Nonfat Greek Yogurt
25mL (1 tbsp + 2 tsp) Egg Whites
2.1mL (1/2 tsp) Vanilla Extract (optional)

Dry:
10g (1 tbsp + 1 tsp) All Purpose Flour
10g (1/3 Scoop) Casein Protein Powder
5g (2 tsp) Oat Flour
24g (2 tbsp) Granulated Sugar Substitute
1g (1/4 tsp) Baking Soda
Pinch of Salt

Ingredients for Brownie Batter:

Wet:
120mL (1/2 Cup) Egg Whites
80g (1/3 Cup) Plain or Vanilla Nonfat Greek Yogurt
120g (1/2 Cup) Pumpkin Purée
120mL (1/2 Cup) Almond Milk

Dry:
35g (1/4 Cup) All Purpose Flour (you can add more flour to make it denser)
72-96g (6-8 tbsp) Granulated Sugar Substitute
20g (2/3 Scoop) Whey/Casein Blend Protein Powder
25g (1/4 Cup) Black or Dark Cocoa Powder
2g (1/3 tsp) Baking Soda
2g (1/2 tsp) Baking Powder
Pinch of Salt

Cookie Topping:
10g Chocolate Chips

Directions:
1. Preheat oven to 180°C/350°F and lightly spray two 5-or 6-inch springform pans.
2. Mix the cookie batter wet and dry ingredients separately, then combine.
3. Mix the brownie batter wet and dry ingredients separately, then combine. Do not overmix.
4. Divide the brownie batter evenly between both pans.
5. Dollop the cookie batter over the brownie batter, gently spread, and add choc chips.
6. Bake 28-38 min (6-inch) or 32-42 min (5-inch), until the edges are set and the centers are slightly soft.
